text:
maya: Quick heads up — starting onboarding for kronos-7b-quant. I'm uploading weights to s3://redwood-models/kronos/kronos-7b/quant/v1/ and opened PR #4321 with runtime config. Need a quick config review before we kick the container rebuild and canary. Anyone with bandwidth?

alex: Thanks — quick checklist: where's the tokenizer.json? Also any BOS/pad quirks we should be aware of? We had off-by-one issues on previous quant models.

maya: Tokenizer is at s3://redwood-models/kronos/kronos-7b/quant/v1/tokenizer.json. It uses <s> as BOS and pads with <pad>. Test harness flagged a BOS-handling mismatch (models sometimes expect BOS removed). I added unit tests in the pr.

sasha: Are we targeting CUDA 12.4 + Triton 2.4 for this? Our infra images are still on CUDA 12.3 in CI, last time 12.4 required a kernel recompile for some int8 kernels.

ryan: I can handle the container rebuild but need the exact matrix (CUDA/CUDNN/Triton + ORT/TF/PyTorch backend). Is this ONNX+ORT or PT Inductor path? Also any specific kernel selector flags?

maya: Exported to ONNX, we're using TRT-friendly quant flow with ORT fallback. PR config snippet:
```
runtime: 
  model: kronos-7b-quant
  backend: ort
  kernel_selector: auto
  quant_profile: int8_trt_compat
  tokenizer_path: s3://redwood-models/kronos/kronos-7b/quant/v1/tokenizer.json
```
Note: kernel_selector=auto might pick a kernel that is unavailable on older CUDA/Triton combos.

jen: Small suggestion — pin kernel_selector to a safe path for the canary (e.g., "fp16_mha_v2" or "fallback_mha") and let auto for the full rollout. Also add a small prompt test set to the canary that would catch BOS off-by-one.

alex: Also, can we add a dedicated canary pool with an ORT fallback model (orion-small) so we can auto-fallback if kernel load fails? If CI sees a kernel error, build/deploy-bot should rollback the canary.

ci-bot: CI: build queued -> build-9876. Tokenizer unit tests: 1 failing (tokenizer.bos handling). See logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9876/logs

maya: I pushed a hotfix that normalizes BOS handling in the tokenizer and updated the test. Can someone retrigger the build? @sasha @ryan

sasha: :thumbsup: retriggering now. If the kernel selector picks an incompatible kernel we'll detect it in the integration smoke; kernel rebuild (if needed) ETA ~45m once I start the compile.

ryan: Adding a note in the PR about CUDA mismatch and linking the kernel rebuild runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kernel-rebuilds — will also annotate the canary to force fallback on kernel-error.

maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. If this lands clean I'll schedule the canary for tomorrow 10:00 PST and coordinate with SRE for monitoring.

jen: LGTM, will follow the canary dashboards and watch the token-level latency and regression alerts.

maya: Closing loop — will post the canary results in #eng-runtime and ping the product owner after the canary completes. :rocket:
